entry.title: temet - character design & visual development
entry.summary:
Temet is an animated series project developed through character design and visual development, with a mysterious, gothic atmosphere at its core.
For this project, I worked on the development of the main cast, exploring silhouettes, proportions, expressions, gestures and colour to define distinct personalities and establish a cohesive visual language.
The designs are built around the darker and more mysterious side of the world of Temet, balancing gothic influences with expressive, character-driven design and a visual language suited to animation.
The project includes character lineups, gesture and expression studies, and colour development.

entry.title: Character concepts - Collection
entry.summary: A curated collection of character concepts exploring silhouettes, shapes, costumes, personalities, and visual storytelling across different projects.
entry.content:
Autor(es): NICKOLAS LYRE

A curated collection of character concepts exploring silhouettes, shapes, costumes, personalities, and visual storytelling across different projects.


CHARACTER CONCEPTS

collection of outtakes from different projects
2025


--

Sketches

Focusing on exploring ideas through quick sketches, shape variations, and early design decisions. The goal is to establish the character’s overall silhouette, proportions, and visual direction before moving into more detailed development.​​​​​​​



--

Ideation and Thumbnails

Early ideation explores silhouettes, shapes, proportions, and visual directions through quick brush strokes. Thumbnails help identify the strongest ideas before moving into more detailed sketching and character development.



--

Character Iterations and Design Development

This stage highlights the development of characters through their costume and gear design, exploring clothing, materials, and functional details such as weapons and accessories. The goal is to create a cohesive visual language that supports the character’s role and personality.



--

3D Character Concepts

These 3D concept studies use basic forms and quick blockouts to check readability from multiple angles. Working in volume and space helps refine shapes, proportions, and general looks, clarifying the design direction before moving into detailed modeling.



--

Renders and Illustrations

Renders and color explorations that bring the designs together. This stage focuses on lighting, materials, and a polished look that presents the vision of each piece.
